thread:
alice: Quick idea — we should show amortized cache credits per-route in the cost dashboard. Current per-tenant delta is confusing teams. Proposal: distribute prefix/KV cache savings proportionally to route token usage over a sliding window. Thoughts?

ben: +1 but we should weight by cache hit tokens not total tokens; otherwise noisy low-hit routes get undue credit.

carla: Also worried about cardinality. route_id x model_sku x tenant_id will explode our rollups.

dave: Ops-wise we can emit per-minute aggregates at the proxy (route_id, model_sku, cache_hit_tokens, cache_miss_tokens, tokens_total). That avoids event-level ingestion.

ben: That works. Then rollups job can compute windows and allocate credits. We already batch per-minute counts for latency SLOs.

carla: For sampling: storing cache_hit_tokens per-request is heavy. If proxy emits aggregates we avoid sampling math. Agrees with per-minute approach.

rollout-bot: metrics-proxy v3 scheduled to deploy to staging tonight, will enable per-minute route aggregates behind flag.

dave: For UI: show an "amortized cache credit" card with formula tooltip. Suggested formula: credit_route = (route_cache_savings_window * (route_hit_tokens / sum_hit_tokens_window)) * model_cost_weight. We can display both token and estimated $ credit.

carla: model_cost_weight? Are we scaling by model unit cost so an M100 token saved is credited more than a small model token?

dave: Exactly. Otherwise a long tail route hitting a cheap model looks like same savings as an expensive model. Weighting keeps economics aligned.

alice: UX ask: include a toggle "show estimated cache credits" because these are approximations and teams should be able to opt out from the adjusted unit cost view.

ben: Telemetry additions we need: route_id, model_sku, cache_hit_tokens, cache_miss_tokens, tokens_total, fallback_model_flag. Keep cardinality low by rolling up at proxy.

carla: For retention: keep raw per-minute aggregates 7d, precomputed rollups 90d, and monthly summaries for billing audits 13 months. Anyone object?

alice: sounds good. Also add a note: we need an audit-mode calculation that keeps the exact per-model breakdown for legal billing cases. Not the approximated amortized view.

dave: Implementation plan: proxy emits aggregates -> metrics pipeline ingests to econ-rollups -> rollups job computes amortized credits per-route per-window -> UI pulls rollup table and shows card.

ben: Action items: (1) proxy emitters (dave), (2) econ rollup job + schema (ben), (3) UI card + toggle + tooltip (alice + carla), (4) add audit-mode exports for accounting (carla).

alice: I'll add to roadmap and create a GH issue linking telemetry schema and UI mocks. Quick sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to align. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

carla: Quick follow-up — for fallbacks: if routing falls back to cheaper model, credits should follow the actual executed model (fallback flag required).

dave: noted, we'll include fallback_model_flag in aggregates.

ben: Minor math note: when sum_hit_tokens_window=0 (cold starts) fall back to tokens_total weighting and mark as estimated.

alice: good edge-case handling. Meeting invite incoming.
